description:
[Deterministic Italian tax simulation. Pure calculation, read-only, side-effect free]. Simulates employee net take-home salary from Gross Annual Salary (RAL) under post-reform 3-tier IRPEF brackets (23%, 35%, 43%), TUIR employment tax credits (detrazioni lavoro dipendente), statutory IVS social security employee cuts (cuneo fiscale), and regional/municipal surcharges across Italian regions.
Usage: Use this tool to compute worker monthly net pay in Italy. Do NOT use for employer-side total company employment cost (use 'costo_aziendale_dipendente' instead).
Returns: JSON object with { ralEur: number, netAnnualSalaryEur: number, netMonthlySalaryEur: number, monthlyInstallmentsCount: number, grossIrpefEur: number, netIrpefEur: number, employeeInpsDeductionEur: number, regionalSurchargeEur: number, municipalSurchargeEur: number, effectiveTaxRatePercent: number }.

applyTaxWedgeReduction.description: Whether statutory IVS tax wedge reduction applies (cuneo fiscale)

italianRegion.description: Italian administrative region for regional surcharge (e.g. Lombardia, Lazio, Veneto)

name: lordo_netto_irpef_simulator
title: Gross-to-Net Salary & 3-Tier IRPEF Simulator
